I farm 31.5 mu in Quzhou. That's a decent size — bigger than most neighbors. Wheat-maize rotation is what everyone here does, and I put some land into zucchini because it brings cash money, more than grain.

Let me think through each crop.

Winter wheat — I plant around 20 mu usually. I sow in early October after the maize comes off. I use the improved varieties like Jimai 22 that the seed dealer sells, because the old varieties don't yield enough. For fertilizer, I put down compound fertilizer (diammonium, 15-15-15 type) as base before sowing — about 50 kg per mu. Then urea topdressing at jointing stage, maybe 20 kg per mu. That gives me roughly 23 kg N, 8 kg P, 8 kg K per mu. Everyone around here does similar. I irrigate 3 times — after sowing, at jointing, at grain-filling. Wheat here needs water because spring is dry. Pesticide — I spray for aphids and powdery mildew, usually 2 times, sometimes 3 if the weather is warm and wet. I use rotary tillage, not deep plowing, because it's faster and cheaper. Last year I got about 500 kg per mu, I expect similar.

Summer maize — same 20 mu, planted right after wheat harvest in June. I use hybrid seed, Zhengdan 958 or Xianyu 335, whatever the dealer has that year. Maize eats more nitrogen than wheat. I put compound fertilizer at sowing, 40 kg per mu, then topdress urea at the big trumpet stage, 25-30 kg per mu. So about 25 kg N, 7 kg P, 7 kg K. Irrigation 2 times — July and August if no good rain. Pesticide for armyworm and corn borer, 2 sprays. No-tillage, I just drill into the wheat stubble. Yield around 550 kg per mu, good years 600.

Zucchini — I keep about 11.5 mu on this. Zucchini needs a lot of fertilizer and water, but the price is good. I use hybrid seed from the market. Base fertilizer is heavy — I put compound fertilizer plus some chicken manure if I can get it. Call it 20 kg N, 12 kg P, 15 kg K per mu, plus topdressing during harvest. I irrigate maybe 8-10 times because zucchini must have water to keep producing. Pesticide 5-6 times — powdery mildew, aphids, whitefly, it's a constant battle. Plough the land properly for zucchini, not rotary. Yield is hard to compare — maybe 3000 kg per mu over the picking season.
